1243 is not a leap year (1243 mod 4 = 3).  
359 days before Jan 19, 1243 → go back 19 days to Jan 1, 1243 → 340 days left.  
340 days before Jan 1, 1243 → 1242 is a leap year (1242 mod 4 = 2? Actually 1242/4=310.5, remainder 2, so not divisible by 4 → not leap year).  
Days in 1242 after Jan 1: 365 days in 1242. 340 days before Jan 1, 1243 = 365 - 340 = 25 days left in 1242 → Dec 7, 1242 (since Dec has 31 days: 31-25=6 → Dec 6? Let's check: Counting backward from Jan 1: Dec 31 is 1 day before, Dec 30 is 2 days before … Dec 7 is 25 days before Jan 1 (31-7+1=25? No: Dec 7 to Dec 31 is 24 days, so Dec 7 is 25 days before Jan 1? Let's recalc: Jan 1 minus 1 day = Dec 31, minus 2 days = Dec 30 … minus 25 days = Dec 7? Check: Dec 31 (1), Dec 30 (2), … Dec 7 (25). Yes.)  

So 359 days before Jan 19, 1243 = Dec 7, 1242.
